title: Dark Side of Movies: How Bollywood Fuels Crime | Ashutosh Pratihast
description:
Dark Side of Movies: How Bollywood Fuels Crime | Ashutosh Pratihast 

Dark Side of Movies: How Cinema Fuels Crime, Violence & Misogyny - Ashutosh Pratihast

Scripted by - Vijeta Dahiya

In this eye-opening video, Ashutosh Pratihast dives deep into the dark side of cinema and its damaging effects on society and youth. Backed by solid research data, we explore how movies glorify violence, rape culture, and misogyny, leading to a dangerous rise in desensitization. Learn how the entertainment industry is subtly normalizing harmful behavior, and the serious consequences it has on crime rates, especially among the younger generation.

We discuss:

- How cinema fuels violent behavior and desensitizes people to real-world issues.
- The link between movies and the increase in rape cases.
- How misogynistic attitudes in films contribute to real-life gender discrimination.
- Proven data showing the connection between movie content and societal decline.

Stay informed on how the media you consume impacts your mindset and actions. Join the conversation and discover the true impact of movies on our culture. Don't miss out—watch now and share your thoughts in the comments!
